notes.title: The store page of
notes.content:
Thank you all very much for having been waiting patiently so far. We appreciate your understanding.

The store of <Tayutama2 -you're the only one-> ENG ver. is officially OPEN today!

The game is produced by our company's original engine that is based on unity and combines new features such as Steam Cloud & Achivement , it has several features below:
[list]
[*][b]Providing the Mac OS version[/b]

 [*][b]Supporting the Steam Achievement[/b] 

 [*][b]Supporting the Steam Cloud[/b]

 [*][b]Supporting the operation of joystick, so you can enjoy the game on a large screen[/b]

 [*][b]Compatible with ultra-high resolution in full screen mode, so you can enjoy the more clearer fonts[/b]

 [*][b]The insolvable CHI Ver. bug which is due to technology limitations no longer exists.[/b]
[/list]
We start to provide the download of the trial version now. There're two options for you: PC version or Mac version. Have a try!​
